title: AID Protocol v2 — AuditInputManifest
description: Artifact emitted by the orchestrator before dispatching C3, listing all artifact inputs C3 is permitted to consume and a hash of the input set for integrity verification.

allOf.$comment: extends aid-protocol-v2.schema.json envelope (reference only — not a resolved $ref)

audit_input_manifest.$comment: enforced — minimal payload; full schema defined in owning phase

allowlist.$comment: hashed paths C3 is permitted to consume

input_hash.$comment: sha256 of the input set; must equal the consuming audit-report.json's .audit_report.input_manifest_hash (provenance chaining, D7)

prior_pass_summaries.$comment: prior PASS results are never trusted as-is by C3 — either passed through unverified (untrusted) or withheld (excluded)

base_sha.$comment: P065 E-065-1_7: base commit of the reviewed change range (Step 2 emits it at runtime; formalised here, NOT required)

head_sha.$comment: P065 E-065-1_7: head commit of the reviewed change range (Step 2 emits it at runtime; formalised here, NOT required)

codex_brief_files.$comment: P065 E-065-1_7: the sealed Codex brief files (c3/*) Codex is GIVEN — distinct from allowlist[] (what C3 may CITE). Step 2 emits it at runtime; formalised here, NOT required

codex_brief_hash.$comment: P065 E-065-1_7: canonical sha256 over {base_sha,head_sha,codex_brief_files,required_independence_level}; Codex echoes this (NOT input_hash). Step 2 emits it at runtime; formalised here, NOT required

evidence_hashes.$comment: P065 E-065-7_7 8th DONE-review audit ('gate evidence integrity'): authoritative digest+size for the NOT-git-tracked evidence-class allowlist entries (final_report.md, gates_report.json, gates/gates_report.json, verifier-output-*.md, and — IMP-269 Half 2 — a PM-authorized targeted-run receipt) — these are runtime artifacts, not committed source, so unlike other allowlist entries C3 cannot independently verify them via `git show <head_sha>:<path>`. This is what binds a claimed PASS to an immutable value sealed at manifest-build time. Step 6 emits it at build-manifest time; formalised here, NOT required (empty when no evidence-class file exists yet).

ac_source.$comment: IMP-269 Half 1: which source authored c3/bundle-plan-ac.md — plan (AID_PLAN_AC_FILE set + readable), final_report_fallback (fell back to the implementation's final_report.md — the E-064-1_2 failure mode), or stub (no source). If the run's review-profile.json required_lenses[] includes an AC lens (ac_to_test_identity / requirement_test_drift), build-manifest FAILS CLOSED unless ac_source == plan; otherwise a non-plan source only warns and this classification is preserved through to audit-report.json. Emitted at build-manifest time; formalised here, NOT required.
